{"claims":[{"claim_text":"President Biden has taken steps to preserve and expand Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for individuals from countries experiencing armed conflicts, natural disasters, or other crises.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Individuals with Temporary Protected Status (TPS) are given authorization to live and work in the United States without fear of deportation for a temporary period.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Since 2021, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS) has added Afghanistan, Cameroon, Ethiopia, Myanmar, Ukraine and Venezuela to the list of TPS-eligible countries.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DHS has also extended TPS for immigrants from most countries that were already covered by TPS.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"DHS has extended TPS for countries that Trump attempted to terminate.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Support for Congress to pass legislation to provide a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers, farmworkers, careworkers, and other long-term undocumented individuals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Dreamers, farmworkers, careworkers, and other long-term undocumented individuals contribute to the country by paying taxes and contributing to their local economies.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"In his second term, President Biden will continue pressing Congress to pass legislation to provide a pathway to citizenship for Dreamers, farmworkers, careworkers, and other long-term undocumented individuals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
